paragraphs: Flynaut's line, "You will not be a developer who occasionally uses AI," describes how I already work. I am a Pune-based developer with 3 years of full-stack experience at a US-based medical-device company, and I use Claude Code every day. My certifications are Claude Code in Action, Claude Code 101, Claude Certified Developer - Foundations (CCDV-F) and Claude Certified Orchestrator - Foundations (CCAO-F).

At that company I built full-stack web apps, internal AI agents and a CRM, and I penetration-tested 5+ live Google Play apps. That experience means I review AI-generated code critically. My projects show the same habits: PageForge pairs AI drafting with a validator and HubSpot events, and my portfolio backend has Stripe, signed webhooks and 10 end-to-end API tests.

I have not used Emergent or AWS in my listed work, but I learn new tools quickly and can start immediately. My portfolio is at hussain-singapuri.vercel.app and my code is at github.com/huss2003. I would welcome a conversation.
